# Packet 1467: the source paths whose change alters what INGESTION STORES in an artifact record
# (items, rendered text, folder paths, references, graph notes, dead ends, gaps, structure, counts).
#
# A change to any of these moves the declared ingestion revision (ingestion_revision.txt, generated by
# scripts/ingestion_revision.py --write at release preparation). An update whose installed build is
# older than the incoming tree's revision marks existing schema artifacts "Needs re-ingestion".
# Anything not listed (Explorer/Diff presentation, routes, templates, docs, tests, the build number)
# does not move it.
#
# One repository-relative path per line. A line ending in "/" covers everything under it.
# "path::function" covers only that function's source, for a file that also holds read-side code:
# changing how a stored record is read back or displayed is not a change to what ingestion stores.
# tests/test_needs_reingest_1467.py fails if a module ingestion loads is not covered.

corpusfm/ingestion/
corpusfm/core/parser.py
corpusfm/core/schemas/
corpusfm/core/rendering/
corpusfm/core/xref/
corpusfm/core/structure_catalog/
corpusfm/core/structure_intent.py
corpusfm/core/identity.py
corpusfm/core/occurrence_titles.py
corpusfm/core/layout_objects.py
corpusfm/core/filenames.py
corpusfm/core/render_diagnostics.py
corpusfm/core/safe_xml.py
corpusfm/core/addon/
corpusfm/formula/
corpusfm/artifact/
corpusfm/tools/gap_analyzer.py
corpusfm/tools/xml_inspector.py
corpusfm/storage/artifact_record.py::build_record
corpusfm/storage/local.py::_safe_dir_name
